claim: Deterministic-first Stage 3 semantic grounding repair for the four development-only extended violation types, plus a strict, fail-closed LLM semantic-grounding fallback implementation that is NOT real-run without explicit API authorization. This revision does not modify the frozen three-type results, the 33-item human Gold, the 40-variant controlled panel, or the s3_formula_repair_v2 evidence.

action_grounding.fallback_policy: ambiguous or unresolved action grounding may trigger the LLM semantic-grounding fallback only when deterministic structural evidence is not decisive; unresolved never becomes a violation by default.

required_condition_not_enforced.negative_evidence: not_enforced only when the action-anchored upstream surface is fully enumerated, no conditionExpression exists, no matching condition text exists, and the action grounding candidate set has structural consensus. A non-matching conditionExpression makes the result ambiguous, not violating.
required_condition_not_enforced.score_meaning: enforced / not_enforced / ambiguous / not_applicable; no 1-similarity logical verdict is fabricated.

direct_evidence: explicit numeric time limits in bound timers, boundary timers, directly associated annotations, nested timers of a locally reached subProcess
constraint_violated.decision: explicit numeric upper bound contradicted by a strictly larger bound => violated; an equal-or-tighter bound => satisfied; no numeric bound in a fully enumerated action-bound surface => not_enforced; unsupported abstract constraints (without undue delay, without hindrance, clear language, purpose/usage restrictions) => ambiguous / LLM fallback or unknown, never a deterministic similarity verdict.
constraint_violated.unchanged: the explicit numeric contradiction logic is retained and must not be shortcut by text similarity.

direct_evidence: boundary event attached to a locally reachable activity
error/escalation definition reachable through such a boundary event
alternate branch whose target label semantically matches the rule exception
exception_not_handled.negative_evidence: not_handled only when the action-grounded downstream surface is fully enumerated, no structurally relevant handler exists, and no non-matching handler candidate blocks the conclusion; handler semantics that cannot be matched deterministically stay ambiguous.
exception_not_handled.scope_limit: ordinary alternate branches are not treated as exception handlers unless their target label matches the rule exception or an exception cue.

prohibited_action_present.decision: prohibition modality plus an explicit exact/normalized or strongly overlapping activity presence; not a raw global text-similarity threshold.

llm_fallback.evidence_id_validation: every evidence id must exist in the compact input local context; hallucinated or missing ids reject the response and produce unknown

evaluation.primary: development-only paired five-class evaluation with abstention retained and no sample dropped
